summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for phase 59 (fuse-ipns-verify-publish-hardening-and-cleanup) end-to-end: research, pattern mapping, planning, and verification.
summary.outcome: Four plans and four waves were created, consolidated onto the correct feat branch, and the plan-checker verification agent was spawned. PATTERNS.md was committed as a late fix after discovering a gap in the workflow.

repo: Phase 59 is 'fuse-ipns-verify-publish-hardening-and-cleanup', req HARD-10, six todo writeups in .planning/todos/pending/ with file/line-level findings on durability-critical FUSE Rust files.
TEE re-sign risk (Finding F) is NOT present: TEE republish path bypasses the embedded-sequence gate entirely. Unifying FUSE to embed=1 is still recommended to allow removal of a verify.rs hotfix.
TS API surface extractor finds nothing on Rust-only phases; safe to omit as a planner hint.
Nyquist, pattern-mapper, and security threat-model gates are all enabled for this project.
Pattern mapper found 9/9 analogs for phase 59.
auto_chain_active flag in phase frontmatter must be cleared when plan-phase is invoked manually without --auto/--chain.
workflow: GSD planner creates a stray branch (docs/plan-phase-<N>) instead of committing to the feat/<slug> branch — documented gotcha requiring manual consolidation via fast-forward merge and branch deletion.
PATTERNS.md is written by gsd-pattern-mapper but no plan-phase step commits it; it becomes an untracked orphan unless explicitly staged. Gap exists in step 13d of the workflow.
commit_failed in the GSD commit helper is a known false-negative; actual commits land correctly.
The feat/<slug> branch is auto-created by the commit helper when committing RESEARCH/VALIDATION; the planner then opens a separate docs/ branch, so the final consolidation step is always necessary.

friction: GSD planner violated the Git Branch Invariant by committing to docs/plan-phase-59 instead of feat/fuse-ipns-verify-publish-hardening-and-cleanup, requiring manual branch consolidation.
PATTERNS.md was left as an untracked orphan because no plan-phase step is responsible for committing it — discovered and fixed manually mid-session.
commit_failed false-negative from commit helper creates ambiguity about whether commits actually landed, requiring a separate verification step.
open_items: Plan-checker (gsd-plan-checker) verification result was still pending at session end — outcome unknown.
Six todos in .planning/todos/pending/ must be archived to .planning/todos/completed/ as part of phase execution (injected as a planner requirement but not yet done).
Unify FUSE publish path to embed=1 to allow removal of the verify.rs hotfix (TEE re-sign risk is absent but the unification cleanup is still recommended).
Plan-phase workflow should be updated to explicitly commit PATTERNS.md after gsd-pattern-mapper completes.
